entries.question: Opd cardiology book Krna hai
entries.answer:
To book an OPD appointment for Cardiology at KGMU, you can use any of the following methods. Online pre-booking is strongly recommended, and the OPD slip fee is ₹50 for all booking methods.

### Booking Methods:
1. **Online via ORS:** Visit the [Online Registration System (ORS)](https://ors.gov.in), select Uttar Pradesh, choose KGMU, select the Cardiology department/date, enter patient details, pay the ₹50 fee, and download your slip.
2. **Via SMS:** Send an SMS in the format `Appointment [Patient Name]` to **8887019134**.
3. **Walk-in:** Visit the hospital with your Aadhaar number and active mobile number to collect a physical token, pay ₹50, and get your OPD slip at the counter (counters close at 1:00 PM sharp).

**Timings:** Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM; Saturday, 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM (closed on Sundays). 

*Note: Outside-city patients must bring a valid referral for the specific department.*

entries.question: Mai gaon ka hu, par mere area me koi qualified doctor nahi hai, sabhi medical store waale hi hai. To mujhe referral slip milna muskil hai
entries.answer:
Aapko is baat ke liye pareshan hone ki bilkul zaroorat nahi hai. Agar aapke gaon mein koi qualified doctor ya CHC/PHC available nahi hai aur wahan sirf medical store wale hi hain, toh aisi sthiti mein aap in steps ko follow kar sakte hain:

1. **Nazdeeki CHC/PHC ya District Hospital jayein:** Agar aapke gaon ke paas koi Sarkari Community Health Centre (CHC), Primary Health Centre (PHC), ya District Hospital (Sarkari Aspatal) hai, toh aap wahan ke kisi MBBS doctor se mil sakte hain. Wahan ke doctor aasaani se aapko KGMU ke liye referral slip likh kar de denge.
2. **Purani Reports Saath Rakhein:** Agar aapne pehle apne gaon ya kisi private lab se koi जांच (jaise Ultrasound Scrotum) karwayi hai, toh uski report zaroor apne sath rakhein. Yeh report bhi referral slip ki kami ko poora karne mein madad karti hai.
3. **Bina Referral ke bhi Jaa Sakte hain:** Agar kisi karanvash aapko referral slip na mil paaye, tab bhi aap online appointment (`ors.gov.in`) lekar KGMU ja sakte hain. Wahan registration counter ya OPD mein doctor ko apni samasya (jaise varicocele/hydrocele) aur gaon mein doctor na hone ke baare mein bata sakte hain. 

Aap apna online appointment pakka karke samay par KGMU (Gate No. 2, Urology Department, 4th Floor) pahunchein, wahan hospital ka staff aapko aage ki process mein madad kar dega.

entries.question: Refel slip kya hota hai, ye mere paas nahi hai
entries.answer:
**Referral slip** ek aisi likhit parchi (prescription ya letter) hoti hai jo aapke local area ke kisi qualified doctor, community health center (CHC), primary health center (PHC), ya kisi anya hospital dwara di jati hai. 

Isme yeh likha hota hai ki patient ko kis bimaari ke shak mein KGMU ke kis vishesh department (jaise Urology) mein beja ja raha hai.

### Kya yeh aapke paas honi zaroori hai?
- KGMU ke niyamo ke anusaar, **jo mareez Lucknow se bahar (doosre shehron ya gaon) se aate hain**, unke liye local doctor ki referral slip lana zaroori hota hai taaki unhe wahan ke local level par pehle dekhe jane ki pushti ho sake.
- Agar aap **Lucknow ke hi rehne wale hain**, toh aam taur par referral slip ki zyada anivaryata nahi hoti.

### Agar aapke paas referral slip nahi hai, toh kya karein?
1. **Preshan na hon:** Agar aapke paas referral slip nahi hai, tab bhi aap online appointment le kar hospital ja sakte hain. 
2. **Local Doctor se banwa lein:** Agar samay ho, toh apne nazdeeki doctor ya clinic se ek choti si slip banwa lein jis par likha ho ki aapko Urology check-up (Varicocele/Hydrocele) ke liye KGMU refer kiya jata hai.
3. **Walk-in / Direct Visit:** Agar aap bina referral ke jayenge, toh kai baar registration counter par ya doctor ke room ke bahar aapko is baari mein pucha ja sakta hai. Lekin agar aapke paas pehle ki koi purani investigation reports (jaise scrotum ka Ultrasound agar karwaya ho) hain, toh aap unhe zaroor dikha sakte hain.

Aap apni booking ke mutabik samay par pahunchein, wahan staff aapko sahi margdarshan de dega.

entries.question: Maine kisi bhi tarike ka ultrasound scortum nahi kar hai
entries.answer:
Agar aapne abhi tak koi Ultrasound Scrotum nahi karwaya hai, toh isse koi pareshani nahi hai. Aap bina kisi purani report ke bhi KGMU ja sakte hain. 

Aapko kya karna chahiye:

1. **Direct Doctor ko Dikhayein:** Aap apne online appointment ke mutabik KGMU ke Urology Department (4th Floor) mein doctor se milein.
2. **Doctor ki Salah Lein:** Doctor aapki samasya (jaise ki varicocele ya hydrocele ke lakshan) sunenge. Agar doctor ko zarurat lagegi, toh weh aapko wahi KGMU ke andar hi **Ultrasound Scrotum** karwane ki likh kar de denge.
3. **KGMU mein hi Jayaz Daamon par Test:** KGMU ke andar hi sarkari rates par yeh jaanch ho jati hai, jiska kharcha baahar ke private centres ke muqable bahut kam hota hai.

Aap bina kisi chinta ke apna appointment poora karein aur taiyar hokar samay par hospital pahunchein.

entries.question: Online appointment kaise book kre
entries.answer:

   * New Appointment par click karein, department aur date select karein.

2. **ABHA / Health Care App ke dwara:**
   * Mobile number aur OTP se register karein.
   * State aur KGMU hospital select karke upar di gayi process ko follow karein.

3. **SMS ke dwara:**
   * `Appointment [Patient Name]` likhkar **8887019134** par SMS bhejein.

**Zaroori Baatein:**
* Online appointment ke liye ₹50 slip fee lagti hai.
* Online registration mandatory hai.

entries.question: Lari Cardiology Appointment booking

entries.question: Online appointment kese lu
entries.answer:
To book an online appointment for KGMU OPD, you can use the Online Registration System (ORS) or other convenient methods. Here are the booking options:

### 1. Booking via ORS (Online Registration System)
1. Go to the official portal: [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in)
2. Register or log in using your mobile number.
3. Select **Uttar Pradesh** as your state and choose **King George's Medical University (KGMU)** from the hospital list.
4. Select **New Appointment**, choose the required department (such as Urology), and select an available date and time.
5. Fill in the patient details, complete the **₹50** online payment for the OPD slip, and download/print the appointment slip.

### 2. Booking via ABHA / Health Care App
- Register using your mobile number and OTP on the government health care app, then follow the same state and hospital selection flow as ORS.

### 3. Booking via SMS
- Send an SMS in the format: `Appointment [Patient Name]` to **8887019134**.

### Important Notes:
- Online registration is mandatory before visiting the OPD.
- OPD timings are Monday to Friday (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) and Saturday (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM); closed on Sundays. 
- The ticket/parchi counter closes at 1:00 PM sharp.
- For assistance, you can contact the KGMU helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.

entries.question: Online appointment lene ke baad mujhe kya kya karna hoga, aur kharcha kitne tak aa sakta hai
entries.answer:
Online appointment lene ke baad aur KGMU visit ke samay aapko in baaton ka dhyan rakhna chahiye:

### Hospital Pahunchne Ke Baad (Process)
1. **Documents saath lein:** Apni booking slip (printout ya digital), Aadhaar card, aur agar koi purani medical reports ya referral slip (agar aap Lucknow se bahar ke hain) hai, toh use zaroor saath rakhein.
2. **Reporting:** Appointment wali date par samay se (9:00 AM se pehle) hospital pahunchein.
3. **OPD Counter:** Gate 2 (Main Hospital/OPD) par jayein. Wahan se aapko apni booking slip dikhakar OPD ticket/parchi collect karni hogi (agar zaruri ho toh).
4. **Room Tak Pohanch:** Apne allotted department (Urology - 4th Floor, Room 420/421) jayein aur wahan ke nursing counter par apni slip dikhayein taaki aapka naam patient list mein shamil ho jaye.

### Kharcha (Expenses)
- **OPD Slip Fee:** Online booking ke samay aap ₹50 pehle hi de chuke honge.
- **Consultation:** OPD ke andar doctor ko dikhane ki koi alag se fees nahi hoti.
- **Tests aur Investigation:** Doctor dwara likhe gaye tests (jaise Ultrasound, blood test, ya semen analysis) ka kharcha alag hota hai. KGMU mein sarkari rates bahut kam hote hain.
    - Rate list ke mutabik, chote tests ₹20–₹500 ke beech ho sakte hain.
    - Agar koi major scan (jaise CT/MRI) likha jata hai, toh uska kharcha ₹100 se ₹5500 tak ho sakta hai (depends on the test).
- **Medicines:** KGMU mein kai zaruri dawaiyan lab ya pharmacy se sasti mil jati hain, lekin kuch bahar se bhi leni pad sakti hain.

**Kuch Zaruri Tips:**
* **Referral:** Agar aap Lucknow se bahar ke patient hain, toh apne local doctor se ek referral slip zaroor banwa kar layein, isse registration mein aasani hoti hai.
* **Bheed:** KGMU mein bahut bheed hoti hai, isliye shanti banaye rakhein aur apni baari ka intezar karein.
* **Safety:** Kisi bhi anjaan vyakti ko apni medical files ya details na dein. Sirf official counter par hi baat karein.

*Disclaimer: Main medical advice nahi de sakta. Yeh jaankari sirf hospital ke official protocols par aadharit hai. Kripya apna ilaaj karane ke liye hamesha qualified doctor se hi paramarsh lein.*

entries.question: Ct angiography ka liya kasay prosess kare
entries.answer:
To get a CT Angiography (CT Scan) done at King George's Medical University (KGMU), follow this general process:

1. **Consult a Doctor / OPD Visit:** 
   - First, consult a physician or specialist at the relevant KGMU OPD department (such as Cardiology, Neurology, or Surgery) with a valid prescription or recommendation for a CT Angiography.
   - OPD registrations are done online via [ORS Government Portal](https://ors.gov.in) or by visiting the hospital counters. (OPD timings: Mon–Fri 9:00 AM–1:00 PM; Sat 9:00 AM–12:00 PM).

2. **Booking & Fee Payment:**
   - Take your prescription to the billing/counter in the Radiodiagnosis department or the respective billing section to get the test scheduled. 
   - KGMU charges range generally between ₹150 to ₹5,500 depending on the specific type of radio-diagnosis procedure required.

3. **Preparation & Contrast Guidance:**
   - CT Angiography often requires an intravenous (IV) contrast dye. The billing or radiology staff will give you specific instructions regarding fasting or blood tests (such as a S. Creatinine test to check kidney function) prior to the scan.

4. **Location & Performing the Scan:**
   - Head to the **Department of Radiodiagnosis** on the scheduled date and time with your receipt, OPD slip, and relevant medical history/reports.

For inquiries, you can contact the PRO Office at **9415007710** or the main helpline at **0522-2258880**. 

*Disclaimer: I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal details in this chat for your safety.*
